descriptor.name: Utah State Parcels
descriptor.operator: Utah Geospatial Resource Center and local government
descriptor.scope: Salt Lake County only, enforced by County=SaltLake; capital-area sample.
caveats: County-scoped capital-area acceptance only; statewide compilation completeness varies.
descriptor.attribution: Utah Geospatial Resource Center and local government. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.

evidence: The frozen city packet and service review identify UGRC and local-government cadastral parcel-boundary geometry for Salt Lake County, with native PARCEL_ID and a polygon containing the unchanged WUP point.

First-party UGRC Utah Parcels documentation (https://gis.utah.gov/products/sgid/cadastre/parcels/) states that SGID contains parcel boundaries for every Utah county and directly links the Salt Lake County basic-parcel service; Salt Lake is listed with September 2026 currency.

Anonymous official polygon-layer schemas confirm PARCEL_ID and pagination. A bounded native-ID read proves that the frozen Salt Lake County polygon equals the production UtahStatewideParcels polygon with County=SaltLake. The descriptor preserves the existing production source ID, prefix, codec, endpoint and county filter as directed by the packet nextStep; scope is the unchanged WUP point and bounded nearby cells, without a municipal-boundary or citywide-completeness claim.
